settingsBbeNoteBody.en: The Bible in Basic English originally left some verses untranslated or heavily truncated. For those ({count} verses), the World English Bible (WEB) text is shown instead and marked with a WEB badge.
settingsBbeNoteBody.fr: La Bible in Basic English a laissé certains versets non traduits ou très abrégés. Pour ceux-ci ({count} versets), le texte de la World English Bible (WEB) est affiché à la place, avec un badge WEB.
settingsBbeNoteBody.it: La Bible in Basic English ha lasciato alcuni versetti non tradotti o molto abbreviati. Per questi ({count} versetti) viene mostrato il testo della World English Bible (WEB), segnato con un badge WEB.
settingsBbeNoteBody.ro: Bible in Basic English a lăsat unele versete netraduse sau mult prescurtate. Pentru acestea ({count} versete) se afișează textul World English Bible (WEB), marcat cu o insignă WEB.
settingsBbeNoteBody.sw: Bible in Basic English iliacha baadhi ya mistari bila kutafsiriwa au ikiwa imefupishwa sana. Kwa hiyo ({count} mistari), maandishi ya World English Bible (WEB) yanaonyeshwa badala yake na kuwekwa alama ya WEB.
settingsBbeNoteBody.tl: May mga talatang hindi isinalin o pinaikli nang husto sa Bible in Basic English. Para sa mga iyon ({count} talata), ipinapakita ang World English Bible (WEB) na may markang WEB.
